summary.text: Steve Parsons (Steven Gene Parsons) is the Libertarian Party nominee for Arkansas's 1st Congressional District and a resident of Lakeview. A consultant and former adjunct professor with a doctorate in economics, he was also the Libertarian candidate for the seat in 2024. He is running on cutting inflation through deregulation and tariff elimination, immigration reform, and reducing incarceration.

paragraphs.text: Works as a consultant and has worked as an adjunct professor; Little Rock Public Radio reported in 2024 that he has a doctorate in economics and has taught the subject.
Is a Libertarian from Lakeview, Arkansas, according to Talk Business & Politics.

Advanced from the Libertarian convention as a candidate for Arkansas House District 3 in 2022, and in 2024 was the Libertarian nominee for the 1st Congressional District, receiving 3.1% (8,353 votes) in the general election won by Rick Crawford.

In a 2024 interview, described his political philosophy as centered on limited government, a plain reading of the Constitution and individual choice, and said he was running to give voters options beyond the two major parties.
Advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on February 22, 2026, to the general election ballot.
